craft_notes: Sthāyin: grant-joy. labdhvā (got) kept vs dattvā. Close: wishing. Rejected: 'boons' — killed.

lines: They come, pledge got, by Bhairava sped —
supreme fruition grant, whatever fruit is sought.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yadvā samīhitam |

reads_against.argmap: Come, pledge got, Bhairava-urged — they give supreme accomplishment, whatever fruit wished.
c1_essence: Come, pledge got, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
